description: Converts a place name or address into coordinates using OpenStreetMap. Returns matching places with lat/lon, a display label and the OSM id. Provider "nominatim" (default) is best for addresses; "photon" is typo-tolerant and better for fuzzy place names.

countrycodes.description: Restrict to countries: comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, e.g. "de,lu" (Nominatim only)

language.description: Language for place names (IETF code like "en" or "de"), default "en"

name: geocode

label.description: The display name, as mappers wrote it.

title: Geocode a place or address
